fields.label: Factual summary
fields.instructions: Summarize only the supplied accepted facts. Cover design, population, interventions, sample size, primary endpoints, and interim plans. Do not add assessments, concerns, conclusions, or new facts. Cite the original sources supplied with those facts.

fields.label: Reviewer assessment
fields.instructions: Reviewer's assessment and conclusions; never request this from Elsa.

fields.label: Submission description
fields.instructions: Describe the submission and current protocol identifier, version, and date as supplied.

fields.label: Product information
fields.instructions: Summarize relevant sponsor-provided product background from the registered documents.

fields.label: Relevant review history and agreements
fields.instructions: Summarize documented previous reviews, agreements, meetings, and regulatory events from supplied sources. Do not infer history from silence in the protocol.

fields.label: Primary objectives
fields.instructions: Extract each primary objective verbatim. Exclude all secondary and exploratory objectives from this field.

fields.label: Secondary objectives
fields.instructions: Extract every secondary/key secondary objective verbatim, retaining sponsor priority labels. Do not select items by perceived statistical importance.

fields.label: Study population
fields.instructions: Summarize the target population and important eligibility boundaries, including age and disease status as stated.

fields.label: Treatment Allocation and Randomization
fields.instructions: Summarize the sponsor's treatment-assignment procedure, including randomized, concurrent-control, minimization, or single-arm design.

fields.label: allocation ratio
fields.instructions: Quote the allocation ratio and its named arms exactly. Do not infer a ratio from sample sizes.

fields.label: stratification factors
fields.instructions: List stated randomization stratification factors and categories; distinguish these from analysis covariates.

fields.label: Blinding
fields.instructions: State who is blinded and who can access allocation before database lock. Do not equate open label with an absence of blinded assessment.

fields.label: Treatment Arms
fields.instructions: Structural label; not an extraction field.

fields.label: experimental
fields.instructions: Summarize every experimental arm, including intervention, dose, route, and schedule where stated. Include the intervention in a single-arm study.

fields.label: control
fields.instructions: Summarize every control/comparator arm and its regimen where stated.

fields.label: Site(s)
fields.instructions: Summarize site counts and countries/regions, and US enrollment percentage if stated. Do not infer subject proportions from site counts.

fields.label: Other features
fields.instructions: Summarize explicitly stated additional design features such as manufacturing delays or lot-consistency requirements. Do not evaluate adequacy or identify deficiencies.

fields.label: Primary
fields.instructions: Extract each primary endpoint's complete definition verbatim, including time windows, event/response definitions, and derivation rules wherever specified. Exclude secondary endpoints.

fields.label: Secondary
fields.instructions: Extract all secondary/key secondary endpoint definitions verbatim, retaining sponsor priority labels. Do not omit endpoints because they seem less important.

fields.label: Hypotheses and parameters
fields.instructions: Quote formal hypotheses and parameter definitions for the named primary endpoint. Retain comparison direction and named arms. Do not construct a hypothesis if none is stated.

fields.label: Non-inferiority/equivalence margin
fields.instructions: Quote applicable non-inferiority/equivalence margins and the sponsor's stated justification for the named primary endpoint. Do not evaluate the justification.

fields.label: Study success criterion
fields.instructions: Quote the sponsor's success criteria for the named primary endpoint and its role in overall study success, including joint requirements and testing order.

fields.label: Primary analysis
fields.instructions: Structural label; not an extraction field.

fields.label: statistical method
fields.instructions: Summarize the specified statistical method for this named endpoint, retaining named arms/comparisons and estimand details if supplied.

fields.label: covariates or strata
fields.instructions: List analysis covariates/strata for this named endpoint; distinguish them from randomization strata.

fields.label: analysis set
fields.instructions: Describe the sponsor's analysis-set membership and treatment-assignment rules for this endpoint, not just its acronym. Include any sponsor-supplied rationale; do not request or judge justification.

fields.label: missing data handling
fields.instructions: Summarize missing-data and censoring rules/time points for this endpoint. Keep the main analysis distinct from sensitivity procedures.

fields.label: α-level
fields.instructions: State alpha, sidedness and sponsor-described multiplicity/gatekeeping procedures for this endpoint, including its relation to other endpoints and interim testing.

fields.label: Sensitivity/supportive
fields.instructions: Summarize sponsor-planned sensitivity/supportive methods, populations and missing-data approaches for this endpoint.

fields.label: Subgroup analysis
fields.instructions: Summarize sponsor-planned subgroup analyses for this endpoint. Do not add subgroup requirements or reviewer recommendations.

fields.label: Primary analysis
fields.instructions: Structural label; not an extraction field.

fields.label: statistical method
fields.instructions: Summarize the specified statistical method for this named endpoint, retaining named arms/comparisons and estimand details if supplied.

fields.label: covariates or strata
fields.instructions: List analysis covariates/strata for this named endpoint; distinguish them from randomization strata.

fields.label: analysis set
fields.instructions: Describe the sponsor's analysis-set membership and treatment-assignment rules for this endpoint, not just its acronym. Include any sponsor-supplied rationale; do not request or judge justification.

fields.label: missing data handling
fields.instructions: Summarize missing-data and censoring rules/time points for this endpoint. Keep the main analysis distinct from sensitivity procedures.

fields.label: α-level
fields.instructions: State alpha, sidedness and sponsor-described multiplicity/gatekeeping procedures for this endpoint, including its relation to other endpoints and interim testing.

fields.label: Sensitivity/supportive
fields.instructions: Summarize sponsor-planned sensitivity/supportive methods, populations and missing-data approaches for this endpoint.

fields.label: Subgroup analysis
fields.instructions: Summarize sponsor-planned subgroup analyses for this endpoint. Do not add subgroup requirements or reviewer recommendations.

fields.label: Interim analysis plan
fields.instructions: Summarize whether interim efficacy, futility, safety analyses or sample-size re-estimation are explicitly planned. Distinguish absence of a plan from inability to locate it. Explicit no-interim statements are found facts.

fields.label: Adaptive features
fields.instructions: Summarize sponsor-described adaptive features; do not judge their appropriateness.

fields.label: Number of interim looks
fields.instructions: State the number and purpose of planned interim looks, distinguishing scheduled testing from other monitoring.

fields.label: Statistical method/approach
fields.instructions: Summarize the method specified for this named interim look, retaining cited method names/references as supplied.

fields.label: Timing and boundaries at each look
fields.instructions: Summarize timing/information fraction, event counts, boundaries, alpha spending, and binding/nonbinding rules for this named look. Do not assess safety adequacy.

fields.label: Operating characteristics
fields.instructions: Summarize supplied stopping/continuation probabilities and their stated scenarios for this look; do not compute missing values.

fields.label: Number of subjects to be accrued/evaluated
fields.instructions: State planned total and per-arm accrual and expected evaluable subjects, keeping endpoints/calculation scenarios explicit. Include medical/regulatory sizing reasons if stated.

fields.label: Type-I error rate (one or two-sided)
fields.instructions: State sponsor-reported sizing alpha and sidedness, with endpoint/scenario associations.

fields.label: Power
fields.instructions: State sponsor-reported target or achieved power, with endpoint/scenario associations. Do not verify or compute power.

fields.label: Assumed values in the estimation
fields.instructions: Structural label; not an extraction field.

fields.label: Treatment effect size
fields.instructions: Summarize sponsor-assumed effect sizes and arm-specific values, naming each endpoint/scenario. Keep assumed true differences distinct from margins.

fields.label: Standard deviation
fields.instructions: State sponsor-assumed standard deviations for named continuous endpoints/scenarios.

fields.label: Dropout/missing rate
fields.instructions: State sponsor-assumed dropout/missingness and how it enters each named sizing scenario.

fields.label: Others
fields.instructions: Summarize other stated sizing assumptions, including overdispersion, accrual and follow-up. Do not invent missing inputs.

fields.label: Rationale provided for assumed values
fields.instructions: Summarize only the sponsor's supplied rationale/evidence for sizing assumptions. Do not supply a justification or evaluate adequacy.

fields.label: Number of events required to stop/complete the trial
fields.instructions: State required event counts by endpoint/scenario and distinguish final from interim targets.

fields.label: Calculation verification
fields.instructions: Independent reviewer verification; manual only. Elsa's sponsor-reported calculation cannot populate this field.

fields.label: Other important issues
fields.instructions: Reviewer assessment of other important issues; manual only.

fields.label: Review-team comments
fields.instructions: Reviewer-authored internal comments; manual only.

fields.label: Sponsor comments and questions
fields.instructions: Reviewer-authored sponsor comments; manual only.
